name: HY-Motion: Peak. While kneeling behind cover, keep the left hand permanently supporting the base of the pistol grip in a compact, two-handed tactical ready position at the chest. Swiftly lean the upper torso, head, and extended arms together to the right side to peek out from cover. Fire a single controlled shot with the arms locked and steady. Immediately snap the entire upper body back behind cover by reversing the lateral lean, keeping the two-handed grip locked tight to the chest throughout.
